title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity bump v1.83.0
author: Maya Thompson
description: Context: ongoing effort to converge SDK behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go for auth surface, retry semantics, streaming ergonomics, and parity of helper utilities. This PR collects language-specific fixes and a small set of behavioral changes required to match the runtime expectations of the platform (see ENG-2134, PM-542). Motivation: customer integrations and internal tooling expect consistent retry/backoff behavior and a uniform streaming API (both for chunked and event-based streams). Changes are intentionally small per-language but applied together to keep releases aligned. Summary of changes: - Python: exported a unified AuthSession with automatic token refresh hooks, normalized retry policy config keys (max_attempts -> retries.max_attempts), and simplified streaming iterator API (StreamChunk -> async iterator yielding chunks and final event). - TypeScript: added auth middleware parity with Python (auto refresh + credential cache), introduced a streaming helper that returns an async iterable and an onClose hook, and fixed some typing ergonomics for function/tool-calling streams. - Go: introduced AuthClient with background token refresh support, normalized retry config struct, and stabilized stream Reader interface to match other SDKs. Also bumped package versions to v1.83.0 across SDKs and updated CHANGELOGs. Testing: unit and integration tests updated for each SDK; e2e harness tested against local redwood server in CI. Checklist: - [x] Python unit + mypy - [x] TS build + typecheck - [x] Go unit + vet - [x] E2E against local dev server - [x] Docs/CHANGELOG updated Rollout plan: release SDK packages in a coordinated batch. No runtime breaking changes expected for typical usage (see release_notes). If consumers were using undocumented internals, slight import path changes may be visible; note included in release notes.
